comment: Variation of level-one-upstairs-after-restore: a dwarven Valkyrie saves while still standing on the D:1 up staircase, so the restored map shows the hero rather than the stairs. The second segment's only input is ':', whose look_here() -> stairs_description() reads the restored stairway from restore.c rest_stairs() and reports the staircase up out of the dungeon. Seeds, datetimes, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
